content.short: Indonesian digital banking app with cards and accounts.
content.description: Jenius is a pioneering Indonesian digital banking app launched by Bank BTPN (now part of SMBC) that lets users manage their money entirely from their smartphones. It offers a primary account with a debit card, sub-accounts and savings features such as Flexi Saver and Dream Saver, multi-currency accounts for holding foreign currencies, and tools for splitting bills, budgeting, and sending money. Aimed at Indonesia's young, digitally savvy consumers, Jenius popularized app-based banking in the country with a design-led experience and transparent fees. By combining everyday accounts, cards, savings, and foreign-currency features in one app, Jenius competes with both traditional Indonesian banks and newer digital banks for the region's fast-growing base of mobile-first customers.
